definitions.reference_pgexp_link: The comparison's reference, PGExp-Link, runs errata 2's command: errata 1's with --train_pgexplainer added, the repository's own training parameters, none tuned. Without that option baselines/pgexplainer_link.py never trains the PGExplainer's mask generator (lines 55 and 117-125). This is a reproduction with an explicit correction of the documented procedure: neither the repository nor the paper shows that this command produced the published 0.578 (the maintainer's decision of 2026-10-19; https://github.com/klucilla/refute/issues/158#issuecomment-6267417453).
definitions.scope: Every claim is full_training (plan section 5: full training, or evaluation of a released checkpoint): each run optimizes the explainer's masks from the start (pagelink.py, baselines/gnnexplainer_link.py or baselines/pgexplainer_link.py) and eval_explanations.py scores those masks. The repository's trained link predictor, saved_models/synthetic_model.pth of the pinned commit, is a pre-trained input loaded frozen, declared as weights that are a file of the repository; it is never trained by the run, and these claims do not test its training (wp3-repository-weights-acceptance.md, reviewed by Codex on 2026-10-19).
definitions.transcription_approval_time: approvals.transcription.approved_utc is 2026-10-18T16:52:05Z, the time of the maintainer's approval comment (https://github.com/klucilla/refute/issues/158#issuecomment-6252536898). The frozen inventory attached carries 2026-10-18T17:05:00Z, a value derived from the local time stated in the maintainer's message; the correction is recorded in https://github.com/klucilla/refute/issues/158#issuecomment-6252562691, and the inventory is not edited (the maintainer's decision of 2026-10-19).
definitions.verdict_paths: No attack applies to these claims (the seed and the split are fixed in the code, with no argument), so the verdict of each claim rests on its base reproduction alone: when the base run completes it is REPRODUCED or NOT_REPRODUCED, never FRAGILE; NOT_REPRODUCIBLE or INCONCLUSIVE remain possible when the base reproduction cannot be obtained (the maintainer's decision of 2026-10-19).
